spoken_summary: An interviewer asks Vice President Kamala Harris what her favorite dish is. Harris responds that one of her favorites is gumbo. She explains that she grew up with a 'second mother,' Mrs. Shelton from Louisiana, who made the best gumbo, and that she has been a lifelong 'gumbo apprentice' trying to learn the recipe.
